verified_facts.text: Seeterrasse has Lake Fuschl views and serves global cuisine made from fresh local ingredients.
verified_facts.excerpt: Seeterrassee offers stunning Lake Fuschl views and global cuisine crafted from fresh local ingredients

verified_facts.text: Schloss Restaurant serves Salzkammergut dishes with fresh local ingredients and curated wines in a relaxed fine dining setting.
verified_facts.excerpt: Embark on a culinary journey with authentic Salzkammergut dishes, fresh local ingredients, and curated wines, all served in a relaxed fine dining setting.

verified_facts.text: Vinothek is a cozy alpine lodge serving Austrian food and local wines, a relaxed spot for guests and hikers.
verified_facts.excerpt: Cozy alpine lodge serving Austrian flavors and local wines. A relaxed spot for guests, hikers, and mountain moments.

verified_facts.text: Sisi Teesalon serves handmade cakes and pralines with daily afternoon tea and becomes a bar in the evening.
verified_facts.excerpt: Enjoy handmade cakes and pralines with daily afternoon tea, transforming into an elegant bar as evening falls.

verified_facts.text: The Schloss Bar includes the historic Whiskey Room for intimate gatherings.
verified_facts.excerpt: Additionally, guests can experience intimate gatherings in the historic Whiskey Room.

verified_facts.text: See Club is a lakeside spot serving fresh seafood and grill specialties by the water.
verified_facts.excerpt: Unwind by the water and relish in an array of fresh seafood and grill specialties accompanied by unforgettable sunsets.

verified_facts.text: The hotel's fisherman, Gerhard, has worked Lake Fuschl since the 1980s and supplies smoked lake-to-table fish.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our fisherman Gerhard has worked the waters of Lake Fuschl since the 1980s, providing delicately smoked, lake-to-table fish

verified_facts.text: The hotel has its own bee colony, whose honey is served at breakfast and sold in the boutique.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our own bee colony produces exquisite honey, served at breakfast and available in our boutique

verified_facts.text: Dining partner Walter Grüll has made Austrian caviar since 1981, including albino sturgeon roe.
verified_facts.excerpt: Walter Grüll has crafted fine Austrian caviar since 1981, including rare albino sturgeon roe

verified_facts.text: The lakefront rooms have marble bathrooms with rain showers and sofas.
verified_facts.excerpt: Featuring marble bathrooms with refreshing rain showers and sumptuous sofas, these residential-style lakefront rooms blend Austrian elegance with modern luxury.

verified_facts.text: Suites have private terraces or patios.
verified_facts.excerpt: Featuring private terraces or patios, the beautifully designed suites offer a memorable and peaceful getaway in a stunning setting.

verified_facts.text: Accommodation also includes houses and chalets.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our impeccable houses and chalets offer authentic immersion in exquisite natural surroundings

verified_facts.text: Signature Suites have a heritage style inspired by imperial refinement.
verified_facts.excerpt: Inspired by imperial refinement, our Signature Suites blend rich textures, noble details, and a heritage ambiance

verified_facts.text: Guests can join herbal expert Martina on a hike to learn about regional herbs and then make their own herbal salt.
verified_facts.excerpt: Follow Martina, a herbal expert, on a hike to learn about regional herbs and their qualities, before creating your own herbal salt.

verified_facts.text: The Hidden Gems of Lake Fuschl experience combines a hike, a ride on a traditional Zille boat and a lake-to-plate visit to the historic Schloss fishery.
verified_facts.excerpt: Embark on a scenic hike, board a traditional Zille boat, and arrive at the historic Schloss fishery for a lake-to-plate experience.

verified_facts.text: Asaya Spa has a winter garden retreat.
verified_facts.excerpt: Pure relaxation awaits at Asaya Spa, where serenity blends with nature in our peaceful wintergarden retreat.

verified_facts.text: Asaya Spa offers massages and facials.
verified_facts.excerpt: Unwind with soothing massages and revitalizing facials

verified_facts.text: A cocktail class teaches the hotel's seasonal cocktails inspired by local ingredients.
verified_facts.excerpt: Discover the secrets behind our seasonal cocktails inspired by local ingredients.

verified_facts.text: Rosa Salon is an intimate space for private dining or meetings.
verified_facts.excerpt: An intimate space ideal for private dining or focused meetings, offering a cozy and professional atmosphere.

verified_facts.text: Chef Julian prepares the fish supplied by fisherman Gerhard.
verified_facts.excerpt: Fresh, local flavors from our fisherman, Gerhard, crafted by Chef Julian.
